import json, collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
answers[58]['slots']['2']='u'
answers[58]['confidence']['2']='low'
answers[58]['note']='Slot 2 is worn and blurred at the stem top; the presence of a left flag is uncertain.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers:
  f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(answers)==len(items)
for r,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ('ъ','ь','other','u') for v in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ('high','low') for v in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ('yes','no','unclear')
counts=collections.Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print(json.dumps({'items':len(answers),'slot_calls':counts,'items_with_unmarked_final_hard_signs':sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers),'count_order_slot_coverage':'passed'},ensure_ascii=False))
